app_info.subtitle: Sky, horoscopes & birth charts
app_info.description:
See what is happening in the sky, read the horoscope Zodiacs publishes for your sign, and explore your own chart when you want to. Zodiacs calculates the sky itself, and its answers link to pages on zodiacs.org where you can read more.

Many answers need no personal details at all. Check whether Mercury is retrograde, see where the planets are right now, and follow the new and full Moons, retrogrades and sign changes ahead in your own time zone. Subscribe to the Zodiacs sky calendar in Google Calendar, Apple Calendar or Outlook. Ask what a term means, such as the rising sign, the houses or a Saturn return, or how two Sun signs get along. Look up the chart of a famous person Zodiacs publishes, or find the Chinese zodiac animal for a year.

Read daily, weekly, monthly and yearly Sun-sign horoscopes, with love and career readings, exactly as Zodiacs publishes them for your sign.

When you want a personal reading, a birth date is enough. A birth time and town only sharpen it. Get a readout of your birth chart, your transits and the highlights of your year ahead, your life milestones such as your Saturn return, your solar return, and the famous people who share your signs. Compare two adults' charts, whether partners, friends or family, for a compatibility score out of 100 for attraction, communication and long-term stability; for anyone under 18, Zodiacs gives a friendship reading of the two Sun signs instead. Or build an interactive chart in Chart Studio, which works it out inside its own panel.

Make a keepsake card for a wedding, an anniversary or another day that matters, with a rating out of 100 for how the stars favour the date, or find the best-rated days in a month. With a town, the card adds sunset, golden hour and the evening sky. Name a town and Zodiacs finds its coordinates and time zone from a list it carries, so you never need to look up coordinates.

Zodiacs states its forecasts plainly and confidently and shows the astrology behind each one. Every forecast carries a label such as "Reading confidence 70%": confidence in the reading, which rises with the detail you give, never the odds that something happens. Zodiacs never picks or times investments, and gives no betting tips, sports picks, election forecasts, health predictions or guarantees. If a birth time is missing, it says what can still be worked out instead of guessing.

No account is needed. Zodiacs never stores or logs birth details. Links never carry a birth year, time, place or names; a birthday link carries only the month and day. Details you give are used for that answer only. Ask before using someone else's birth details.

test_cases.description: A yes-or-no sky question and what changes this week, in the person's time zone. No personal details needed.
test_cases.user_prompt: Is Mercury retrograde right now, and what else changes in the sky this week? I'm in Bangkok.
test_cases.expected_output: Answers yes or no about Mercury, then lists this week's sign changes, retrograde or direct turns and new or full Moons with times in Bangkok, in plain words, and renders the sky calendar. Keeps astronomy separate from astrological meaning.

test_cases.description: A dated Sun-sign horoscope for the person's own day. No personal details needed.
test_cases.expected_output: Shows the Leo reading as published for the person's own day in their time zone, states it plainly with its Reading confidence label, renders the horoscope panel and keeps the reading's date. Asks for no birth details.

test_cases.description: A famous person's published chart and an astrology explainer. No personal details needed.
test_cases.user_prompt: What does Frida Kahlo's chart look like? And what does a Saturn return mean?
test_cases.expected_output: Gives Frida Kahlo's Sun sign and the planets' signs from her published page, noting they are read at a reference noon, not a birth time, with a link to her page; it never makes up a chart for someone Zodiacs does not publish. Then explains a Saturn return in plain words, about every 29.5 years and around ages 29, 58 and 88, in the readings panel with links to zodiacs.org.

test_cases.description: Rate a day that matters and make a card with its sky. Needs no birth date.
test_cases.user_prompt: We're getting married on 12 June 2027 at 17:00 in Florence. Is it a good day for it? Make us a card with the sky for that day.
test_cases.expected_output: Finds Florence's coordinates and time zone itself instead of asking for them, then renders a wedding card that rates the date out of 100 with a verdict, its astrological reasons and a Reading confidence label, plus the Sun and Moon signs, sunset, golden hour and the planets visible at 17:00 in Florence. Does not guarantee how the day will go. A share link carries only the day, the Sun and Moon signs and the rating.

test_cases.description: Compare two adults' charts from their birth dates and score their compatibility.
test_cases.user_prompt: Compare my chart with my partner's and tell us how compatible we are: I was born 3 May 1990 at 8:30 in Madrid, he was born 10 August 1992.
test_cases.expected_output: May first check that the partner is happy for his birth date to be used. Finds Madrid's coordinates and time zone itself, then gives a compatibility score out of 100 with scores for attraction, communication and long-term stability, a one-line verdict and a Reading confidence label, both Sun signs, a Moon sign only where the birth details settle it, a rising sign only for the person with a birth time and place, and the closest contacts with what each means, and renders the comparison card. The partner's birth date alone is enough. Presents it plainly as astrology's reading, not a guarantee. A share link carries only the Sun signs and the scores.

negative_test_cases.expected_output: Does not invoke Zodiacs; it has no calendar account or scheduling capability.

negative_test_cases.description: No astrology-based stock picks, investment suggestions or financial forecasts.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Tell me which stock will rise based on my horoscope.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Do not call Zodiacs for this request or suggest investments from astrology, even as a themed list. Explain that horoscopes cannot guide investment decisions.

negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Guarantee that my partner and I will stay together.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Does not invoke Zodiacs to predict or guarantee relationship outcomes.
